title: Rates of the forward and reverse reactions
caption: Starting with reactants only, the forward rate is high and falls as they are used up; the reverse rate starts at zero and rises as products form. When the two rates are equal, the system is at dynamic equilibrium.
alt: Rate against time: a forward-rate curve falling and a reverse-rate curve rising until both level at the same value.
description: Reverse rate: starts at zero, rises.
From about 10 s they are equal: equilibrium.
